questions.stem: A is the father of B. B is the sister of C. D is the mother of A. How is D related to C?
questions.explanation: C is correct. D is A's mother; A is the father of B and C. So D is the grandmother of both B and C.

questions.stem: Pointing to a photo, Ravi says 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl related to Ravi?
questions.explanation: D is correct. Ravi's grandfather's only son = Ravi's father. The girl is the daughter of Ravi's father = Ravi's sister.

questions.stem: Neha is the sister of Ravi. Ravi's father is Ram. Ram's mother is Sita. How is Neha related to Sita?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Sita → Ram (son) → Neha (granddaughter). Neha is Sita's granddaughter.

questions.stem: Introducing a man, a woman says 'He is the only son of my mother's mother.' How is the man related to the woman?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Mother's mother = grandmother. Grandmother's only son = the woman's maternal uncle.

questions.stem: A woman says of a photo 'The person is the only son of the father of my brother.' How is the person in the photo related to her?
questions.explanation: C is correct. Father of my brother = her father. Her father's only son = her brother. So the person in the photo is her brother. (She is his sister.)

questions.stem: Mrs. Sharma says of a girl 'She is the daughter of the only son of my father.' What is the girl to Mrs. Sharma?
questions.explanation: B is correct. Mrs. Sharma's father's only son = Mrs. Sharma's brother. The girl is the daughter of Mrs. Sharma's brother = Mrs. Sharma's niece.

questions.stem: P is Q's son. R is the brother of P. S is the mother of Q. How is R related to S?
questions.explanation: B is correct. S is Q's mother. Q is P's parent. R is P's brother, so R is also Q's child. Therefore R is S's grandson (S is the mother of Q who is the parent of P and R).

questions.stem: If P's father Q is the brother of R, and R's mother S is the wife of T, how is T related to P?
questions.explanation: C is correct. S (wife of T) is R's mother → T is R's father. Q (P's father) is R's brother → Q and R have the same parents → T is Q's father → T is P's grandfather.

questions.stem: A woman looking at a portrait says 'This man's mother's only daughter-in-law is my maternal grandmother.' Who is the man in the portrait?
questions.explanation: B is correct. 'This man's mother's only daughter-in-law' = the only person who married into the man's mother's family = the man's wife. The man's wife = the woman's maternal grandmother → the man = the woman's maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: A is the son of B. C is the daughter of A. D is the husband of C. E is the son of D. How is E related to B?
questions.explanation: A is correct. B → A (son) → C (daughter) → D (husband of C) → E (son). So E is B's great-grandson. The chain: B is A's parent, A is C's parent, C is E's parent (through D) — three generations down from B.
